summary: Union County site on the Wallowa-Whitman, dated only to the 1930s; firelookout.com calls it abandoned and possibly never used; no construction or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Both sources say abandoned; the brief's 'gone' is not supported by either

corrections.why: firelookout.com and the Oregon lookout list both say abandoned, and neither says the structure was removed or destroyed

evidence.supports: 1930s date; abandoned; may never have been used; possible proposed site
evidence.quote: 1930s: unknown. Abandoned. May never have been used, possible proposed site.

evidence.supports: Oregon lookout list: coordinates, type unknown, status abandoned
Forest Lookouts index places the site in Union County
West Eagle is on the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

notes_for_editor: The story runs about 124 words, just over the 120-word floor, because the three sources give only a location, a 1930s date, an abandoned status and a possible-proposal note; it was not padded. Two WebSearch queries found no West Eagle lookout record; Mount Emily, Hat Point and Red Hill results are other lookouts and were not used. The brief's status 'gone' is not supported; see corrections. The Forest Lookouts page gives little beyond the location.
